Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Lord Krishna explains the eternal lineage of the sacred yoga science, revealing that He originally imparted this knowledge to the sun-god Vivasvan, who then passed it to Manu, who instructed Iksvaku.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Establishing the ancient, divine origin and royal purpose of spiritual wisdom.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna reveals the original transmission of Bhagavad-gita: Krishna → Vivasvan (sun-god) → Manu (father of mankind) → Iksvaku (king of earth).
Outcome/Resolution: Establishes that leadership and governance must be guided by timeless spiritual wisdom to protect and uplift society.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Timeless Wisdom Foundations: Grounding life in enduring principles rather than temporary trends
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Leadership Responsibility: Using authority and influence to protect and guide others ethically
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Ancestral and Generational Guidance: Drawing strength and wisdom from continuous lineage traditions

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Imam vivasvate yogam proktavan aham avyayam (I instructed this imperishable yoga to Vivasvan)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna traces the origin of Bhagavad-gita to primordial times, revealing how spiritual knowledge was handed down to saintly rulers to maintain cosmic and societal order.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Anchoring mindsets in timetested values provides emotional stability and direction during chaotic times, reminding individuals that wisdom is an inherited human strength.
